headline: ATBS volume recovery expected in H2FY27

highlights: Change in Estimates Current Previous FY28E FY29E FY28E FY29E Rating ACCUMULATE ACCUMULATE Target Price 1,081 1,278 Sales (INR mn) 30,861 34,283 30,455 33,988 % Chng. 1.3 0.9 EBITDA (INR mn) 7,617 8,612 7,875 8,869 % Chng.
ATBS demand is showing meaningful improvement, with Q3 volumes expected to be strong following customer destocking in H1, while antioxidants, IB and IBB delivered strong performance.
Management expects FY27 revenue growth of 20–25%, with EBITDA margin guidance of 24–25%, improving to 25–26% in FY28.
The antioxidants business is expected to sustain its growth momentum, supported by market expansion.
